shortDefinition: AI systems that can process and generate multiple types of content: text, images, audio, and video.
fullDefinition: Multimodal AI refers to AI systems that work with more than one type of data (modality). Modern multimodal models like GPT-4o, Gemini, and Claude can process text, images, documents, and audio simultaneously — and in some cases generate images and audio as well. This enables use cases like 'analyze this photo', 'transcribe this audio', and 'generate an image from a description'.
examples: GPT-4o analyzing a chart image and summarizing the data
DALL-E generating an image from a text description
